question: Select the most appropriate meaning of ‘fastidious’ from the following options.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Concerned about accuracy and detail**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning of ‘**fastidious**’ from the given options is "**concerned about accuracy and detail**".
 
• In the context of the given passage, it is mentioned that **Darcy** is **clever** and at the same time, he is **haughty, reserved, and fastidious**, and **his manners, though well bred, were not inviting**.
 
• Here, the word '**fastidious**' means that Darcy is **very attentive and concerned** about **accuracy and detail**.

Thus, ***option 4*** is the correct answer.
